desc: pack: the root handle is not marked as the last child
old: internal EsaNode Root => new(0, _n, 0, 0, _n, true);
new: internal EsaNode Root => new(0, _n, 0, 0, _n, false);

desc: pack: ISA stores rank + 1
old: for (int rank = 0, count = index.SuffixArray.Length; rank < count; rank++) isaBuf[saBuf[rank]] = rank;
new: for (int rank = 0, count = index.SuffixArray.Length; rank < count; rank++) isaBuf[saBuf[rank]] = rank + 1;

desc: pack: ISA misses the last rank
old: for (int rank = 0, count = index.SuffixArray.Length; rank < count; rank++) isaBuf[saBuf[rank]] = rank;
new: for (int rank = 0, count = index.SuffixArray.Length - 1; rank < count; rank++) isaBuf[saBuf[rank]] = rank;

desc: pack: Isa() rejects position n
old: if ((uint)position > (uint)_n) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(position));
new: if ((uint)position >= (uint)_n) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(position));

desc: pack: PayloadBytes forgets the pyramid
old: internal long PayloadBytes => (4L * _isa.Length) + _pyramid.LevelBytes;
new: internal long PayloadBytes => 4L * _isa.Length;

desc: pack: the null node does not throw
old: if (node.Lb < 0) throw new ArgumentException("the null node has no suffix link", nameof(node));
new: if (node.Lb < -1) throw new ArgumentException("the null node has no suffix link", nameof(node));

desc: pack: the root test also requires Lb == 0 (the root is the only node of depth 0)
old: if (node.Depth == 0) return Root;                        // the root
new: if (node.Depth == 0 && node.Lb == 0) return Root;       // the root
equivalent_expected: equivalent: the root is the only node of depth 0 and has Lb = 0

desc: pack: a leaf is recognised as Lb == Rb - 1
old: if (node.Lb == node.Rb) return LeafLink(node);           // a leaf: the leaf of the next suffix
new: if (node.Lb == node.Rb - 1) return LeafLink(node);       // a leaf: the leaf of the next suffix

desc: pack: a node of depth 2 links to the root
old: if (t == 0) return Root;                                  // an internal node of depth 1
new: if (t <= 1) return Root;                                  // an internal node of depth 1

desc: pack: the right endpoint uses the rank before Rb
old: int b = isa[sa[node.Rb] + 1];
new: int b = isa[sa[node.Rb - 1] + 1];

desc: pack: the left endpoint is ISA at Pos instead of Pos + 1
old: int a = isa[node.Pos + 1];
new: int a = isa[node.Pos];

desc: pack: the parent depth is the smaller of the two border values
old: return new EsaNode(left, right - 1, t, Math.Max(leftValue, rightValue), sa[left], leftValue > rightValue);
new: return new EsaNode(left, right - 1, t, Math.Min(leftValue, rightValue), sa[left], leftValue > rightValue);

desc: pack: the last-child flag uses >=
old: return new EsaNode(left, right - 1, t, Math.Max(leftValue, rightValue), sa[left], leftValue > rightValue);
new: return new EsaNode(left, right - 1, t, Math.Max(leftValue, rightValue), sa[left], leftValue >= rightValue);

desc: pack: Pos of the target is SA of the right border
old: return new EsaNode(left, right - 1, t, Math.Max(leftValue, rightValue), sa[left], leftValue > rightValue);
new: return new EsaNode(left, right - 1, t, Math.Max(leftValue, rightValue), sa[right - 1], leftValue > rightValue);

desc: pack: the target depth is the node depth (not depth - 1)
old: return new EsaNode(left, right - 1, t, Math.Max(leftValue, rightValue), sa[left], leftValue > rightValue);
new: return new EsaNode(left, right - 1, t + 1, Math.Max(leftValue, rightValue), sa[left], leftValue > rightValue);

desc: pack: the terminator-only leaf does not link to the root
old: if (position >= _n) return Root; // the terminator-only leaf of the root
new: if (position > _n) return Root; // the terminator-only leaf of the root

desc: pack: the leaf link has the leaf's own depth
old: return new EsaNode(rank, rank, leaf.Depth - 1, Math.Max(left, right), position + 1, left > right);
new: return new EsaNode(rank, rank, leaf.Depth, Math.Max(left, right), position + 1, left > right);

desc: pack: the leaf link has Pos = position
old: return new EsaNode(rank, rank, leaf.Depth - 1, Math.Max(left, right), position + 1, left > right);
new: return new EsaNode(rank, rank, leaf.Depth - 1, Math.Max(left, right), position, left > right);

desc: pack: the leaf link has no right border value for the last rank (reads rank + 1 past the array)
old: int right = rank < _n ? _pyramid.ValueAt(rank + 1) : -1;
new: int right = rank <= _n ? _pyramid.ValueAt(rank + 1) : -1;

desc: pack: the leaf link's last-child flag uses >=
old: return new EsaNode(rank, rank, leaf.Depth - 1, Math.Max(left, right), position + 1, left > right);
new: return new EsaNode(rank, rank, leaf.Depth - 1, Math.Max(left, right), position + 1, left >= right);
